cards.title: Reader backend: EPUB/PDF parsing + metadata extraction + reading API
cards.description:
Add reader API routes to server.py (or a separate reader_server.py on a new port, if cleaner). Support: (1) POST /api/reader/import — accepts EPUB/PDF file path, parses metadata (title, author, cover image) and full text, stores in ~/dot/projects/reader/data/ as JSON + extracted text. Use ebooklib for EPUB, PyPDF2 for PDF. (2) GET /api/reader/library — returns all books with title, author, cover, page count, last position. (3) GET /api/reader/book/:id?page=N — returns page N content. The extracted text is chunked by page (every ~3000 chars = 1 page). Keep dependencies minimal (stdlib + ebooklib + PyPDF2). All data stored as JSON files, no database.

---
## Review notes (FAIL)
- **[Design System]** `reader/style.css:524` uses `var(--dot-space-14)` which does not exist in the design system. Valid tokens are `--dot-space-12` and `--dot-space-16`. This causes the padding to collapse to 0 on the mobile reading view.
- **[Edge cases]** `projects/reader/reader_server.py:568` uses `os.getpid()` for the temp upload filename (`"_upload_%d%s"`). With `ThreadingHTTPServer`, two concurrent uploads of the same extension collide on the same temp path, risking data corruption or a race on `os.remove`.

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: reader/style.css
@@ mobile reader-view__page bottom padding uses non-existent --dot-space-14 @@
     padding: var(--dot-space-10) var(--dot-space-4) var(--dot-space-14);
*** Replace With
    padding: var(--dot-space-10) var(--dot-space-4) var(--dot-space-16);
*** End Patch

- Running server still serves `/api/reader/health` and `/api/reader/library` correctly with existing imported books intact.

cards.title: Reader library UI: book grid + import + eye-friendly dark theme
cards.description: Create reader/index.html — the library view. Grid of book cards (cover thumbnail, title, author, progress bar showing X%). Eye-friendly design: dark background (#1a1a1a or similar), warm off-white text, generous spacing, large touch targets. ## Summary

Built the **Dot Reader library UI**, served at `http://127.0.0.1:8080/reader/`, talking to the Reader API on `:8081` (cross-origin; the reader server sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`).

### Files created

- **`reader/index.html`** — semantic shell: sticky app bar (brand + search + Import), library status row, book grid, empty state, error banner, and an inline reading-view overlay. Sets `<html data-theme="dark">` so the design-system dark palette applies.
- **`reader/style.css`** — eye-friendly dark theme using **only `--dot-*` tokens** (verified: zero hardcoded hex). Warm near-black canvas (`--dot-bg`), warm off-white text (`--dot-text-primary`), 2:3 cover aspect ratio, generous spacing (`--dot-space-8/10/16`), large touch targets (`dot-btn--lg`), 760px reading measure, responsive grid (`auto-fill, minmax(180px,1fr)`) collapsing to 140px on mobile. Includes drag-to-import overlay, progress bars, toast spinner, and `prefers-reduced-motion` handling.
- **`reader/script.js`** — vanilla JS, no deps. API base auto-detects `:8081` (overridable via `?api=`).

### Features delivered (per card)

1. **Grid of imported books** with cover thumbnails (or a calm tinted placeholder showing initials + title when no cover was extracted), title, author.
2. **Click to open reading view** — inline overlay fetches `/api/reader/book/:id?page=N`, renders the page, with Prev/Next nav, page counter, % position, and `Esc`/`←`/`→` keyboard shortcuts. The GET persists reading position server-side, so progress bars update after closing.
3. **Progress indicator per book** — `X% read` (from `last_position`) + `p. N / M` page number, plus a `--dot-primary` progress bar.
4. **Import button** — opens a native file picker (`accept=.epub,.pdf`, multiple); uploads each file as a raw body to `/api/reader/import` with the filename in an `X-Filename` header. Also supports **drag-and-drop** anywhere on the page. Shows a spinner toast during import.
5. **Search/filter** by title or author (client-side), with a live match count.

### Backend change (backward-compatible)

The reader server's `POST /api/reader/import` only accepted `{"path": "…"}`, which a browser file picker can't provide (browsers never expose real file paths). I extended `projects/reader/reader_server.py` so the same endpoint now also accepts a **raw file upload** (filename via `X-Filename` header or `?filename=`), spooling to a temp file under `data/` and calling the existing `import_file()`. The JSON `{path}` mode is untouched. Added a 100 MiB `UPLOAD_MAX_BODY` for uploads.

### Verification

- `reader_server.py` and `script.js` parse cleanly.
- Main server serves `/reader/`, `/reader/style.css`, `/reader/script.js`, and `/design-system/*.css` (all 200).
- End-to-end test: imported a real EPUB (with cover) and a PDF via raw upload → `GET /api/reader/library` lists them → `GET /api/reader/book/:id?page=1` returns chunked text and persists position → `GET /api/reader/cover/:id` returns the PNG. Test data was then cleared so the library opens in the clean empty state.
